msi-claw-a1m-135h.note: MSI product render is a straight-on front view with the screen lit. Both straight-on top renders are taller than the spec ratio: h/w about 0.432 against 117/294 = 0.398 (aspect_err retrocatalog 0.082, MSI 0.086). They failed the earlier 8 % limit and pass the current 12 % limit, so top is traced from the retrocatalog front and fitted to 294 x 117. The Claw-A1MX page now redirects to its support page with no gallery, so side and bottom stay boxes.
